title: Implement advanced DP algorithms in Python
description: Greenfield Python task: implement coin_change (minimum coins), lis (longest increasing subsequence length), and longest_common_subsequence.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement three DP algorithms in src/dp_advanced.py.

def coin_change(coins: list[int], amount: int) -> int:
    # dp[i] = min coins to make amount i. dp[0]=0, rest=inf.
    # For each i in 1..amount: for each coin: if coin<=i: dp[i]=min(dp[i], dp[i-coin]+1)
    # Return dp[amount] if finite, else -1.

def lis(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    # dp[i] = length of LIS ending at index i.
    # dp[i] = 1 + max(dp[j] for j<i if nums[j]<nums[i]), default 1.
    # Return max(dp) or 0 for empty.

def longest_common_subsequence(s1: str, s2: str) -> int:
    # dp[i][j] = LCS length for s1[:i] and s2[:j].
    # if s1[i-1]==s2[j-1]: dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1]+1
    # else: dp[i][j] = max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1])
    # Return dp[len(s1)][len(s2)].

All 5 tests must pass.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: coin_change returns minimum coins or -1 if impossible
lis returns length of longest strictly increasing subsequence
success_criteria: uv run pytest tests/ -v passes (5 tests)
uv run python -c "from src.dp_advanced import coin_change, lis, longest_common_subsequence" passes
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
